payload.summary: Expanded the RI-09 scaffold into a coordinated, test-first plan for transactional terminal-event evidence, bounded telemetry, and idempotent HTTPS webhook delivery. Direct code and spec inspection replaced the incomplete cross-layer architecture graph.
completed_work: Reviewed canonical terminal, typed result, notification, telemetry, settings, and reconciliation paths.
Created detailed proposal, design, five spec deltas, closed JSON/DB contracts, tasks, and a six-package DAG.
Validated the OpenSpec change and package graph strictly.

decisions.title: Use a dedicated transactional terminal-event outbox
decisions.rationale: Existing generic notifications commit separately, accept unsafe open payloads, and provide only process-local SSE delivery.

decisions.title: Implement HTTPS webhook as the v1 sink
decisions.rationale: A receiver can honor stable idempotency keys and the transport is deterministic to test without inventing incomplete email identity/configuration.

decisions.title: Capture operation intent with database triggers
decisions.rationale: Canonical terminal transitions have worker, cancellation, handler, and maintenance paths; a trigger closes post-commit crash and bypass windows.
